description.narrative: KRA 1.1 By 2022, improved capacity of MoES (at all levels) in data management and utilization to inform monitoring, planning and budgeting processes

title.narrative: 1.2 Available and functioning improved EMIS data quality and utilization

description.narrative: Points: (1) LESMIS platform supports ICT enabled data entry at school level and use of data at all levels of the system. All MoES staff have access to the Platform, as well as DPs;(2) Capacity development of key staff of 148 DESB and 18 PESS (whole country) in the use of the GIS enabled LESMIS Platform.
